---
title: "Mark"
---

# Mark

::: {.book-summary}
## Book Summary Insight

Mark presents Jesus as the suffering Servant and powerful Son of God. The book emphasizes action, authority, and sacrificial service as the path to true greatness.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 1

<div class="key-verse">Mark 1:17</div>

<div class="identifier">Follow Me, and I will make you fishers of men</div>

### Why This Verse

Famous discipleship call

### Chapter Insight

This chapter introduces John the Baptist, Jesus' baptism, temptation, and early ministry. The key verse presents Jesus proclaiming the arrival of God's kingdom and calling for repentance and faith.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 2

<div class="key-verse">Mark 2:17</div>

<div class="identifier">I came not to call the righteous, but sinners</div>

### Why This Verse

Mission of Jesus

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records healings and growing opposition from religious leaders. The key verse emphasizes Jesus' authority to forgive sins.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 3

<div class="key-verse">Mark 3:35</div>

<div class="identifier">Whoever does the will of God</div>

### Why This Verse

True family of God

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes the appointment of the twelve disciples and increasing conflict. The key verse highlights Jesus' establishment of a community centered on doing God's will.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 4

<div class="key-verse">Mark 4:39</div>

<div class="identifier">Peace, be still</div>

### Why This Verse

One of Jesus' best-known miracles

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contains parables about the kingdom of God. The key verse teaches that spiritual fruitfulness depends on receiving God's Word.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 5

<div class="key-verse">Mark 5:36</div>

<div class="identifier">Be not afraid, only believe</div>

### Why This Verse

Famous encouragement

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records dramatic demonstrations of Jesus' power. The key verse reveals Christ's authority over demons, disease, and death.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 6

<div class="key-verse">Mark 6:34</div>

<div class="identifier">He was moved with compassion</div>

### Why This Verse

Character of Jesus

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts rejection at Nazareth, the mission of the twelve, and the feeding of the five thousand. The key verse emphasizes compassion and ministry despite opposition.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 7

<div class="key-verse">Mark 7:6</div>

<div class="identifier">This people honors Me with their lips</div>

### Why This Verse

True worship

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contrasts tradition with true righteousness. The key verse teaches that defilement comes from the heart rather than external practices.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 8

<div class="key-verse">Mark 8:36</div>

<div class="identifier">What shall it profit a man?</div>

### Why This Verse

One of the most quoted sayings of Jesus

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Peter's confession and Jesus' teaching about discipleship. The key verse identifies Jesus as the Messiah and calls followers to self-denial.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 9

<div class="key-verse">Mark 9:23</div>

<div class="identifier">All things are possible to him that believeth</div>

### Why This Verse

Widely quoted faith verse

### Chapter Insight

This chapter includes the Transfiguration and further teaching on discipleship. The key verse reveals Jesus' divine glory and the necessity of humble service.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 10

<div class="key-verse">Mark 10:27</div>

<div class="identifier">With God all things are possible</div>

### Why This Verse

Parallel to Matthew 19

### Chapter Insight

This chapter addresses marriage, wealth, leadership, and sacrifice. The key verse declares that Jesus came to serve and give His life as a ransom for many.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 11

<div class="key-verse">Mark 11:24</div>

<div class="identifier">What things soever ye desire when ye pray</div>

### Why This Verse

Famous prayer verse

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records the triumphal entry and cleansing of the Temple. The key verse highlights faith, prayer, and God's authority.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 12

<div class="key-verse">Mark 12:30</div>

<div class="identifier">Love the Lord thy God with all thy heart</div>

### Why This Verse

Greatest Commandment

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contains parables and debates with religious leaders. The key verse summarizes true devotion through love for God and neighbor.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 13

<div class="key-verse">Mark 13:31</div>

<div class="identifier">Heaven and earth shall pass away</div>

### Why This Verse

Enduring words of Christ

### Chapter Insight

This chapter presents Jesus' teaching about future events. The key verse emphasizes watchfulness and readiness for His return.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 14

<div class="key-verse">Mark 14:38</div>

<div class="identifier">Watch ye and pray</div>

### Why This Verse

Gethsemane instruction

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records the Last Supper, Gethsemane, and Jesus' arrest. The key verse highlights the New Covenant established through Christ's sacrifice.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 15

<div class="key-verse">Mark 15:34</div>

<div class="identifier">My God, My God, why hast Thou forsaken Me?</div>

### Why This Verse

Crucifixion cry

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts Jesus' trial, crucifixion, and burial. The key verse emphasizes Christ's sacrificial death and the centurion's recognition of His identity.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 16

<div class="key-verse">Mark 16:15</div>

<div class="identifier">Go ye into all the world</div>

### Why This Verse

Great Commission in Mark

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records the resurrection and the commission to proclaim the gospel. The key verse celebrates Christ's victory over death and the spread of the good news.
:::
